text: Added ResolvedPullbackRoute, PullbackProgram, stable PullbackFingerprint, typed MorphismCompilerId, and MorphismCompilerRegistry with identity and affine capabilities. Lowering resolves a complete graph route, validates target rows, records compiler trace, applies coordinate maps in target-to-root order, and exposes distinct support-planning, sparse-assembly, and execution interfaces. Identity lowers to zero steps; missing/duplicate/mismatched compilers are typed SpatialError cases; a Functional test compiler registers without central matching changes. Focused JVM+JS: 6/6 each. Full spatial: JVM 63/63, JS 56/56. Reservation retained because current branch is unrelated and files remain uncommitted.
